heading: About Me
bio: I'm a cyber-security engineer in the Master of Applied Computing co-op at the University of Windsor, with a Bachelor's in Cyber Security from CVR College. My internship at BlueCloud Softech ran the whole loop rather than one slice of it: scan, triage, write it down, and chase the fix until it closed.

Most of my work sits where tooling meets process — Qualys and Nmap findings that turn into tracked remediation, MITRE ATT&CK–aligned detection logic, FortiGate and FortiMail hardening, and Python and PowerShell automation that takes hours out of response. I also co-authored published research on deep-learning botnet detection in IoT network traffic.
quote: I'm a lifelong learner and innovator, driven by a desire to contribute with new ideas and tools that deliver real value.
headline: I find the gaps — then make sure they actually get closed.
